concerns.title: Birth Certificate (Registered in Malolos City)
concerns.titleFil: Sertipiko ng Kapanganakan (Nairehistro sa Malolos)
concerns.stepSummary: Go to City Civil Registry Office (CCRO / LCR) at City Hall Ground Floor. Bring valid government ID and hospital birth record details.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Pumunta sa City Civil Registry Office (CCRO / LCR) sa ground floor ng City Hall. Magdala ng Valid ID at detalye ng kapanganakan.
concerns.note: For official PSA security paper (SECPA) copies required by the DFA for passport applications, visit the PSA Bulacan CRS Outlet at Robinsons Place Malolos.

concerns.title: PSA Birth, Marriage, Death Certificate & CENOMAR (Nationwide SECPA)
concerns.titleFil: PSA Birth Certificate, Kasal, Kamatayan at CENOMAR (Kopya mula sa PSA)
concerns.stepSummary: Book an online appointment at PSA CRS Outlet in Robinsons Place Malolos (crs-appointment.psa.gov.ph) or request delivery via PSA Serbilis.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Mag-book ng online appointment sa PSA CRS Outlet sa Robinsons Place Malolos o mag-order online sa PSA Serbilis.
concerns.note: PSA SECPA copies are mandatory for DFA passport applications, foreign visa processing, PRC board exams, and national transactions.

concerns.title: Marriage License Application & Marriage Certificate Registration
concerns.titleFil: Aplikasyon para sa Lisensya sa Kasal at Rehistro ng Kasal
concerns.stepSummary: Apply for a Marriage License at LCR Malolos at least 2-3 weeks before wedding. Attend mandatory Pre-Marriage Counseling (PMC) with City Health Office and CSWDO.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Mag-apply ng Marriage License sa LCR Malolos 2-3 linggo bago ang kasal. Dumalo sa Pre-Marriage Counseling (PMC) sa City Health Office at CSWDO.
concerns.note: Marriage License is valid for 120 days from date of issuance and can be used anywhere in the Philippines.

concerns.title: Death Certificate Registration, Burial Permit & Transfer Permit
concerns.titleFil: Rehistro ng Sertipiko ng Kamatayan at Permit sa Paglilibing
concerns.stepSummary: Have the Certificate of Death reviewed and signed by the City Health Officer (CHO), then register at LCR Malolos to secure the Burial or Transfer Permit.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Papirmahan ang Certificate of Death sa City Health Officer (CHO), at ipatala sa LCR Malolos upang makuha ang Burial o Transfer Permit.
concerns.note: For burial financial assistance (AICS), coordinate with the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO).

concerns.title: Correction of Clerical Error (RA 9048) & Change of First Name / Gender (RA 10172)
concerns.titleFil: Pagwawasto ng Mali sa Birth Certificate (RA 9048 / RA 10172)
concerns.stepSummary: File a petition for administrative correction at City Civil Registry Office (CCRO) with supporting school records, baptismal certificate, and earliest government IDs.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Maghain ng petisyon sa LCR Malolos kalakip ang Form 137, baptismal certificate, at pinakamaagang valid IDs bilang patunay.
concerns.note: Administrative corrections under RA 9048 and RA 10172 do not require a court order, saving significant legal fees.

concerns.title: Barangay Clearance, Certificate of Residency & Indigency
concerns.titleFil: Barangay Clearance, Katunayan ng Paninirahan at Indigency
concerns.stepSummary: Visit your respective Barangay Hall in any of the 51 barangays of Malolos City with a valid ID and proof of address. Same-day processing.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Pumunta sa inyong Barangay Hall sa alinman sa 51 barangay ng Malolos na may dalang valid ID at patunay ng tirahan. Makukuha sa parehong araw.
concerns.note: Barangay Clearance and Indigency are prerequisites for securing Business Permits, Mayor's Clearance, and CSWDO financial assistance.

concerns.title: Business Permit / Mayor's Permit (New Application & BOSS Annual Renewal)
concerns.titleFil: Permiso sa Negosyo / Mayor's Permit (Bago o BOSS Renewal)
concerns.stepSummary: Secure DTI Registration and Barangay Business Clearance first. Submit application at BPLO Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS) at City Hall ground floor.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Kumuha muna ng DTI registration at Barangay Business Clearance. Isumite sa BPLO Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS) sa ground floor ng City Hall.
concerns.note: Annual business permit renewals are conducted from January 1 to January 20 each year without surcharge.

concerns.title: DTI Business Name Registration (Sole Proprietorship)
concerns.titleFil: Pagpaparehistro ng Pangalan ng Negosyo sa DTI
concerns.stepSummary: Register online at bnrs.dti.gov.ph or visit DTI Bulacan Negosyo Center at the Provincial Capitol Compound.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magrehistro online sa bnrs.dti.gov.ph o bumisita sa DTI Bulacan Negosyo Center sa Provincial Capitol Compound.
concerns.note: DTI Business Name Registration is valid for 5 years and is required before securing an LGU Mayor's Permit.

concerns.title: Tricycle Operator's Franchise (MTOF) & Fare Verification
concerns.titleFil: Prangkisa ng Traysikel (MTOF) at Taripa ng Pamasahe
concerns.stepSummary: Secure TODA endorsement, valid Professional Driver's License, and LTO OR/CR. Submit to BPLO Tricycle Franchising Section.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Kumuha ng TODA endorsement, Professional Driver's License, at rehistro (OR/CR). Isumite sa BPLO Tricycle Franchising Section.
concerns.note: Physical inspection of sidecar safety, lights, and standard fare matrix posting is conducted prior to franchise issuance.

concerns.title: Malolos Public Market Stall Lease & Vendor Permits
concerns.titleFil: Upa sa Puesto sa Palengke at Permiso ng Tindera (SEEDO)
concerns.stepSummary: Apply at the SEEDO Public Market Office in Brgy. Sto. Rosario. Submit vendor application, health certificate, and valid IDs.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Mag-apply sa SEEDO Public Market Office sa Brgy. Sto. Rosario. Isumite ang aplikasyon, health certificate, at valid IDs.
concerns.note: Market vendors must secure annual health cards and sanitary clearance from the City Health Office.

concerns.title: Free Medical Consultations, Child Immunization & Prenatal Care
concerns.titleFil: Libreng Konsulta sa Doktor, Bakuna ng Sanggol at Prenatal Care
concerns.stepSummary: Visit the Rural Health Unit (RHU I to VI) or Barangay Health Center assigned to your barangay during clinic hours.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Pumunta sa nakatalagang Rural Health Unit (RHU I hanggang VI) o Barangay Health Center ng inyong barangay.
concerns.note: Routine doctor checkups, childhood vaccines (BCG, Pentavalent, Polio, Measles), and prenatal vitamins are provided 100% free.

concerns.title: Health Certificate & Food Handler's Sanitary Permit (for Employment/Business)
concerns.titleFil: Health Certificate at Sanitary Permit (para sa Trabaho at Negosyo)
concerns.stepSummary: Undergo required laboratory exams (Chest X-ray, Urinalysis, Fecalysis), then present results to City Health Office (2/F City Hall) for health card issuance.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magpa-laboratory (X-ray, Urinalysis, Fecalysis), at dalhin ang resulta sa City Health Office (2/F City Hall) para sa health card.
concerns.note: Mandatory for all food establishments, salon/spa staff, market vendors, and hotel workers in Malolos City.

concerns.title: Animal Bite Treatment & Anti-Rabies Vaccination (Dog/Cat Bites)
concerns.titleFil: Tulong sa Kagat ng Aso/Pusa at Bakuna sa Rabies (Animal Bite Center)
concerns.stepSummary: Wash the wound immediately with running water and soap for 15 minutes. Proceed immediately to the Animal Bite Treatment Center (ABTC) at City Health Office or Bulacan Medical Center.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Hugasan agad ang sugat sa dumadaloy na tubig at sabon ng 15 minuto. Magtungo agad sa Animal Bite Treatment Center sa City Health Office o Bulacan Medical Center.
concerns.note: Do not apply garlic or traditional herbs. Prompt post-exposure prophylaxis is critical to preventing fatal rabies infection.

concerns.title: Emergency Hospital Care, Surgery & Inpatient Admissions
concerns.titleFil: Pang-emerhensiyang Gamutan sa Ospital at Operasyon (Bulacan Medical Center)
concerns.stepSummary: For life-threatening emergencies, call Malolos Rescue (0928 226 9801) for ambulance transport directly to Bulacan Medical Center (BMC) Emergency Room in Brgy. Mojon.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Sa malubhang emergency, tumawag sa Malolos Rescue (0928 226 9801) para sa ambulansya patungo sa Emergency Room ng Bulacan Medical Center sa Mojon.
concerns.note: Bulacan Medical Center is a PhilHealth-accredited tertiary hospital offering No Balance Billing (NBB) for indigent and sponsored patients.

concerns.title: Senior Citizen ID & 20% Purchase Discount Booklets
concerns.titleFil: Senior Citizen ID at Booklet ng Diskwento (60 Anyos Pataas)
concerns.stepSummary: Bring two 1x1 ID pictures, Barangay Certificate of Residency, and proof of age (PSA Birth Certificate or Valid ID showing 60+ years) to OSCA Malolos.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magdala ng dalawang 1x1 picture, Barangay Certificate, at katibayan ng edad (Birth Certificate o Valid ID na 60+ anyos) sa OSCA Malolos.
concerns.note: Entitles holders to a 20% discount and VAT exemption on prescription medicines, doctor professional fees, groceries, public transportation, and restaurants.

concerns.title: Persons with Disability (PWD) ID Application & Benefits
concerns.titleFil: Aplikasyon para sa PWD ID at Benepisyo sa Kapansanan
concerns.stepSummary: Secure a Medical Certificate with clinical diagnosis from a licensed physician. Submit with 1x1 photos and Barangay Residency Certificate to CSWDO PWD Section.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Kumuha ng Medical Certificate na may diagnosis ng doktor. Isumite kasama ang 1x1 litrato at Barangay Certificate sa CSWDO PWD Section.
concerns.note: PWD ID holders are entitled to 20% discount & VAT exemption on medicines, medical supplies, transport, dining, and priority lane access.

concerns.title: Solo Parent ID & Subsidies (Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act - RA 11861)
concerns.titleFil: Solo Parent ID at mga Benepisyo (RA 11861)
concerns.stepSummary: Submit Barangay Certification of Solo Parent status, child's PSA Birth Certificate, income tax return/indigency, and affidavit to CSWDO.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magsumite ng Barangay Solo Parent Certificate, PSA Birth Certificate ng anak, katunayan ng kita/indigency, at affidavit sa CSWDO.
concerns.note: Under RA 11861, qualified low-income solo parents receive monthly cash subsidies, 10% discounts on baby milk/diapers, and flexible work leave.

concerns.title: Emergency Financial, Medical & Burial Assistance (AICS Program)
concerns.titleFil: Ayudang Pinansyal, Medikal at Tulong sa Libing (AICS Program)
concerns.stepSummary: Prepare Barangay Indigency, Valid ID, and Medical Abstract/Hospital Statement of Account or Funeral Contract. Submit to CSWDO for social case study.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Ihanda ang Barangay Indigency, Valid ID, at Medical Abstract/Statement of Account o Funeral Contract. Isumite sa CSWDO para sa assessment.
concerns.note: Assistance is evaluated based on social case study assessment and local calamity/contingency budget allocation.

concerns.title: Real Property Tax (Amilyar) Payment, Discounts & Tax Declarations
concerns.titleFil: Pagbabayad ng Amilyar sa Lupa at Bahay (Real Property Tax)
concerns.stepSummary: Bring previous year's Official Receipt (OR) or Tax Declaration to City Treasurer's Office (Ground Floor City Hall) for assessment and payment.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Dalhin ang nakaraang resibo (OR) o Tax Declaration sa City Treasurer's Office (Ground Floor City Hall) para sa assessment at pagbabayad.
concerns.note: Prompt payment discounts of up to 20% are granted for advance full-year annual payments made in January.

concerns.title: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula / CTC)
concerns.titleFil: Sedula (Community Tax Certificate)
concerns.stepSummary: Secure in-person at the City Treasurer's Office window at City Hall or at designated Barangay Halls. Same-day instant issuance.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Kumuha sa window ng City Treasurer's Office sa City Hall o sa inyong Barangay Hall. Makukuha agad sa parehong araw.
concerns.note: Required for legal notarization of affidavits, employment onboarding, property conveyances, and government licensing.

concerns.title: Tax Declaration (TD) Issuance, Property Appraisal & Title Transfer Assessment
concerns.titleFil: Pagkuha ng Tax Declaration at Pagtatasa sa Paglilipat ng Titulo
concerns.stepSummary: Submit Deed of Absolute Sale / Title, DAR/BIR eCAR, and previous tax declaration to City Assessor's Office for inspection and new TD issuance.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Isumite ang Deed of Sale, Title, BIR eCAR, at lumang Tax Declaration sa City Assessor's Office para sa bagong Tax Declaration.
concerns.note: Ensures property is properly titled and registered in the Malolos City cadastral registry.

concerns.title: Building Permit, Occupancy Certificate & Structural Renovation Permits
concerns.titleFil: Building Permit, Occupancy Permit at Pagpapatayo ng Bahay/Gusali
concerns.stepSummary: Submit 5 sets of signed/sealed architectural plans, Land Title, Locational Clearance from CPDO, and Barangay Clearance to City Engineering Office.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magsumite ng 5 kopya ng pinirmahang plano ng arkitekto, Titulo ng Lupa, Locational Clearance mula CPDO, at Barangay Clearance sa City Engineering Office.
concerns.note: Constructing without an approved building permit incurs work stoppage orders and administrative fines under the National Building Code (PD 1096).

concerns.title: Report Road Potholes, Clogged Drainage & Defective Street Lights
concerns.titleFil: Ulat sa Sirang Kalsada, Baradong Kanal at Pundidong Ilaw
concerns.stepSummary: Submit an inspection request or photo report with exact street/barangay location to City Engineering Office or your Barangay Hall.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magsumite ng ulat o litrato na may eksaktong lokasyon sa City Engineering Office o sa inyong Barangay Hall.
concerns.note: For national roads (such as McArthur Highway), repair coordination is forwarded to DPWH Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office.

concerns.title: 24/7 Emergency Rescue, Paramedic Ambulance & Flood Evacuation
concerns.titleFil: Saklolo sa Aksidente, Ambulansya at Baha (24/7 Malolos Rescue)
concerns.stepSummary: Call Malolos Rescue hotline immediately: 0928 226 9801 or (044) 760-5160. State patient condition, exact barangay, and nearest landmark.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Tumawag agad sa Malolos Rescue: 0928 226 9801 o (044) 760-5160. Sabihin ang kalagayan ng pasyente, eksaktong barangay, at landmark.
concerns.note: 24/7 command center equipped with emergency ambulances, rubber boats for flood rescue, and trained emergency medical responders.

concerns.title: Fire Emergency Response & Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC)
concerns.titleFil: Sunog (Emergency) at Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (BFP Malolos)
concerns.stepSummary: In case of fire, dial 0995 186 0370 or (044) 791-0300 immediately. For business FSIC inspection, apply through the BPLO BOSS counter.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Sa sunog, tawagan agad ang 0995 186 0370 o (044) 791-0300. Para sa FSIC ng negosyo, mag-apply sa BPLO BOSS counter sa City Hall.
concerns.note: Ensure your home or business has accessible fire extinguishers and clear exit corridors.

concerns.title: Police Emergency Response, Crime Blotter & National Police Clearance
concerns.titleFil: Tulong Pulisya, Blotter at National Police Clearance (PNP Malolos)
concerns.stepSummary: For urgent police assistance, call (044) 791-0222 or 0998 598 5380. For National Police Clearance, register online via pnpclearance.ph.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Para sa tulong ng pulis, tumawag sa (044) 791-0222 o 0998 598 5380. Para sa clearance, mag-apply sa pnpclearance.ph.
concerns.note: Neighborhood community disputes between residents must first undergo Lupon Tagapamayapa mediation at the Barangay Hall.

concerns.title: NBI Clearance Application, Biometrics & Renewal
concerns.titleFil: Pagkuha ng NBI Clearance at Renewal (NBI Bulacan)
concerns.stepSummary: Register and schedule an appointment at clearance.nbi.gov.ph. Pay online, then proceed on your appointment date to NBI Bulacan District Office in Capitol Compound.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Mag-register at mag-set ng appointment sa clearance.nbi.gov.ph. Magbayad online at magtungo sa NBI Bulacan sa Capitol Compound sa araw ng appointment.
concerns.note: Bring 2 valid government IDs and your official NBI reference number receipt.

concerns.title: City College & High School Scholarships (Iskolar ng Lungsod ng Malolos)
concerns.titleFil: Iskolar ng Lungsod ng Malolos at Educational Assistance
concerns.stepSummary: Submit Certificate of Grades (GWA), Certificate of Enrollment/Registration, and Barangay Indigency to the City Mayor's Office - Scholarship Division.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magsumite ng Certificate of Grades, Certificate of Registration, at Barangay Indigency sa Tanggapan ng Mayor - Scholarship Division.
concerns.note: Open for application prior to the start of each semester for bonafide student residents of Malolos.

concerns.title: Local Job Placement, Career Matching & SPES Student Summer Jobs
concerns.titleFil: Paghahanap ng Trabaho (PESO) at SPES para sa Estudyante
concerns.stepSummary: Register in the PESO Malolos Employment Database with your updated resume, 2x2 photo, and skills credentials at the City Hall Compound.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magpalista sa PESO Malolos Employment Database kalakip ang inyong resume at 2x2 litrato sa City Hall Compound.
concerns.note: PESO connects Maloleño jobseekers with vetted local, regional, and overseas employers free of charge.

concerns.title: Public Elementary, High School Enrollment & ALS (DepEd Malolos)
concerns.titleFil: Enrolment sa Pampublikong Paaralan at Alternative Learning System (ALS)
concerns.stepSummary: Visit your local public school or DepEd Schools Division Office in Brgy. Bulihan with the student's PSA Birth Certificate and Form 138 (Report Card).
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Pumunta sa pinakamalapit na pampublikong paaralan o DepEd Division Office sa Bulihan dala ang PSA Birth Certificate at Report Card.
concerns.note: Basic public education in all 51 barangays of Malolos City is tuition-free.

concerns.title: Tree Cutting / Trimming Permits & Solid Waste Management
concerns.titleFil: Permit sa Pagputol/Pagtapyas ng Puno at Koleksyon ng Basura (CENRO)
concerns.stepSummary: Submit a letter of request with photos of the tree and Barangay Endorsement to City Environment & Natural Resources Office (CENRO).
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magsumite ng sulat-kahilingan na may litrato ng puno at Barangay Endorsement sa CENRO City Hall.
concerns.note: Unauthorized cutting of trees without a valid CENRO/DENR permit violates environmental protection laws.

concerns.title: Farmer Registry (RSBSA), Subsidized Seeds, Fertilizer & PCIC Insurance
concerns.titleFil: Rehistro ng Magsasaka (RSBSA), Libreng Binhi, Abono at Seguro sa Pananim
concerns.stepSummary: Enroll in the Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture (RSBSA) at the City Agriculture Office in the City Hall Compound.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magparehistro sa RSBSA sa City Agriculture Office para maging kwalipikado sa libreng binhi, abono, at ayudang pambukid.
concerns.note: RSBSA registration is mandatory to receive Department of Agriculture (DA) fuel vouchers, fertilizer subsidies, and free PCIC crop insurance.

concerns.title: SSS Membership, SS Number, Maternity/Sickness Claims & Pension
concerns.titleFil: SSS Membership, Pagkuha ng SS Number, Pautang at Pensyon
concerns.stepSummary: Visit SSS Malolos Branch at Malolos Commercial Complex or access the My.SSS portal at sss.gov.ph for online services.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Bumisita sa SSS Malolos Branch sa Malolos Commercial Complex o gamitin ang My.SSS portal sa sss.gov.ph.
concerns.note: Bring 2 valid government IDs or your PhilSys National ID when transacting in person.

concerns.title: PhilHealth Registration, Member Data Record (MDR) & PhilHealth ID
concerns.titleFil: PhilHealth Registration, Pag-update ng MDR at PhilHealth ID
concerns.stepSummary: Submit the PhilHealth Member Registration Form (PMRF) and valid ID at PhilHealth Malolos Branch (2/F The Cabanas Mall, Brgy. Longos).
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Magsumite ng PMRF form at valid ID sa PhilHealth Malolos Branch sa The Cabanas Mall, Brgy. Longos.
concerns.note: Indigent residents may also coordinate with CSWDO for LGU-sponsored PhilHealth enrollment under the Universal Health Care program.

concerns.title: Pag-IBIG Housing Loan, Multi-Purpose Loan & MP2 High-Yield Savings
concerns.titleFil: Pag-IBIG Housing Loan, Calamity Loan at MP2 Savings (Robinsons Malolos)
concerns.stepSummary: Visit Pag-IBIG Fund at 2nd Floor, Robinsons Place Malolos or transact online via Virtual Pag-IBIG (pagibigfundservices.com).
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Pumunta sa Pag-IBIG sa Robinsons Place Malolos o mag-apply online sa Virtual Pag-IBIG.
concerns.note: MP2 is a tax-free, government-guaranteed high-yield savings program open to all active Pag-IBIG members.

concerns.title: BIR TIN Application (Form 1904/1901), Authority to Print & Estate Taxes
concerns.titleFil: Pagkuha ng BIR TIN, Resibo at Estate Tax (BIR RDO 25B)
concerns.stepSummary: Proceed to BIR RDO No. 25B at the Provincial Capitol Compound in Brgy. Guinhawa with PSA Birth Certificate and Government ID.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Pumunta sa BIR RDO No. 25B sa Capitol Compound sa Brgy. Guinhawa dala ang PSA Birth Certificate at Government ID.
concerns.note: First-time jobseekers under RA 11261 are entitled to free TIN issuance upon presentation of a First-Time Jobseeker Barangay Certificate.

concerns.title: Driver's License Application, Renewal & Motor Vehicle Registration (OR/CR)
concerns.titleFil: Lisensya sa Pagmamaneho (LTO) at Rehistro ng Sasakyan
concerns.stepSummary: Create an LTMS account (portal.lto.gov.ph), take CDE exam online, and visit LTO Malolos District Office in Capitol Compound with medical certificate.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Gumawa ng LTMS account (portal.lto.gov.ph), kumuha ng CDE exam, at magtungo sa LTO Malolos sa Capitol Compound na may medical cert.
concerns.note: Accredited medical clinics and emission testing centers are situated within the Capitol Compound vicinity.

concerns.title: Voter Registration, Transfer & Voter's Certification
concerns.titleFil: Rehistro sa Botohan (COMELEC) at Voter's Certification
concerns.stepSummary: Visit COMELEC Malolos Office in the City Government Center, Brgy. Bulihan during voter registration periods with valid ID and proof of residence.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Bumisita sa COMELEC Malolos sa City Government Center, Brgy. Bulihan tuwing may voter registration bitbit ang valid ID at patunay ng tirahan.
concerns.note: Voter's Certification can be issued immediately for identification and passport application requirements.

concerns.title: Free Legal Assistance, Representation & Notarization for Indigents
concerns.titleFil: Libreng Tulong Legal at Notaryo (Public Attorney's Office - PAO)
concerns.stepSummary: Bring Barangay Indigency Certificate and case documents to Public Attorney's Office at Bulwagan ng Katarungan, Capitol Compound.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Dalhin ang Barangay Indigency Certificate at mga kaugnay na dokumento sa PAO sa Bulwagan ng Katarungan, Capitol Compound.
concerns.note: PAO provides free legal services to indigent clients whose net family income does not exceed statutory thresholds.

concerns.title: Postal ID Application & Express Postal Mailing (PHLPost)
concerns.titleFil: Pagkuha ng Postal ID at Pagpapadala ng Liham/Package (PhilPost)
concerns.stepSummary: Bring 2 copies of completed Postal ID application form, PSA Birth Certificate, and Barangay Residency Certificate to Malolos Post Office at Capitol Compound.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Dalhin ang application form, PSA Birth Certificate, at Barangay Residency Certificate sa Malolos Post Office sa Capitol Compound.
concerns.note: Postal ID is widely accepted as a primary valid government ID across public and private institutions.

concerns.title: Water Connection, Disconnection, Low Pressure Advisories & Leak Reports
concerns.titleFil: Bagong Linya ng Tubig, Kawalan ng Tubig at Tagas (PrimeWater Malolos)
concerns.stepSummary: Visit PrimeWater Malolos office in Brgy. Bulihan or call (044) 791-5800 / 0917 834 8925 for emergency pipe leak reports.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Bumisita sa PrimeWater Malolos sa Brgy. Bulihan o tumawag sa (044) 791-5800 / 0917 834 8925 para sa ulat ng tagas o kawalan ng tubig.
concerns.note: New water connections require proof of ownership / Barangay Certificate and plumbing layout approval.

concerns.title: Electricity Connection, Power Outages & High Bill Inquiries (Meralco)
concerns.titleFil: Koneksyon ng Kuryente, Brownout at Reklamo sa Bill (Meralco Malolos)
concerns.stepSummary: Visit Meralco Malolos Business Center in Brgy. Dakila or report outages 24/7 via Meralco Hotline 16211 or Meralco Online App.
concerns.stepSummaryFil: Pumunta sa Meralco Malolos sa Brgy. Dakila o mag-ulat ng brownout sa Meralco Hotline 16211 o Meralco Online App.
concerns.note: Certificate of Final Electrical Inspection (CFEI) issued by the City Engineering Office is required prior to energization.
